# MuVAP vendored source

Unmodified MuVAP source used by the Multi-TPC MuVAP comparator.

- Upstream project: Haotian-Qi/MuVAP
- Commit: `a1ef9c8bde873196da2c37be5e74933c497b6a14`
- Archive SHA-256: `8daecdbd5a079e2f271f8c1d1a68b63895de95a7972c08b69088dbf2213b0126`
- License: MIT (see `MuVAP-main/LICENSE`)

The notebooks add `MuVAP-main/` to `sys.path` by default. To use another copy, set `MUVAP_REPO`. The pretrained role-VAP weights are not included; the notebooks download them from the Hugging Face repository `Haotian-Qi/MuVAP` (`vap-role-cpc`).
